name: goal-creator-passive
context: Agent systems where the agent interprets a user's explicit natural-language request to extract and formalize the intended goal before planning begins. The user says what they want; the agent converts this into a structured goal with parameters, constraints, and success criteria. This is the entry point for all agentic workflows — it precedes planning, tool selection, and execution.
benefits: Clarifies ambiguous requests before costly execution begins
Produces explicit success criteria that can be verified after execution
Documents the user's intent in a form that survives context window limits
Enables the agent to catch misaligned expectations early
tradeoffs: Adds a round-trip to confirm goal understanding before execution
Users may find explicit goal-setting cumbersome for simple requests
Poorly phrased goals produce misaligned plans even with perfect execution
Can feel slow if the user already provided a precise request
use_cases: A user asks to book a flight; the agent extracts destination, dates, budget, and preferences
A developer asks to fix a bug; the agent extracts the error message, file location, and expected behavior
A business user requests a report; the agent extracts scope, time range, and delivery format
A support agent receives a complaint; the agent extracts the issue type, customer tier, and urgency
avoid_when: User input is already fully structured (JSON, form data)
The agent operates in a fully autonomous mode with no human in the loop
Tasks are exploratory and goals emerge dynamically during execution
anti_patterns: Skipping confirmation and executing immediately on ambiguous input
Asking the user to reformulate their goal rather than doing it for them
Extracting goals without capturing constraints or success criteria
design_principles: Goal extraction must be explicit enough to support post-hoc verification
The agent should ask clarifying questions when the goal is under-specified
Extracted parameters should be typed and validated before planning begins
best_practices: Confirm extracted goals with the user before beginning execution
Surface the goal in a structured format so the user can correct misunderstandings
Log the extracted goal alongside the final output for traceability
references: Lu et al., Agent Design Pattern Catalogue, 2024 (arXiv:2405.10467) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.10467
